2687-the-snare.description: A book by Rafael Sabatini. art of his too-genial host at Regoa. That is a misconception easily explained. This host’s name happened to be Souza, and the apologist in question has very rashly leapt at the conclusion that he was a member of that notoriously intriguing family, of which the chief members were the Principal Souza, of the Council of Regency at Lisbon, and the Chevalier Souza, Portuguese minister to the Court of St.

arxiv-2002-00399.title: Non-uniqueness for the ab-family of equations Thanks: Department of Mathematics and Statistics, Wake Forest University, Winston Salem, NC 27109, USA, (holmesj@wfu.edu) Thanks: Department of Mathematics and Statistics, Wake Forest University, Winston Salem, NC 27109, USA, (purir@wfu.edu).
arxiv-2002-00399.creator: John Holmes and Rajan Puri
arxiv-2002-00399.description: Abstract . We study the cubic ab-family of equations, which includes both the Fokas-Olver-Rosenau-Qiao (FORQ) and the Novikov (NE) equations. For a ≠ 0 a\neq 0 , it is proved that there exist initial data in the Sobolev space H s H^{s} , s < 3 / 2 s<3/2 , with non-unique solutions.

arxiv-2107-02872.title: On the initial singularity in Kantowski-Sachs spacetime
arxiv-2107-02872.creator: Elham Ghorani, and Yaghoub Heydarzade
arxiv-2107-02872.description: Abstract The emergent universe scenario is a proposal for resolving the Big Bang singularity problem in the standard Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker cosmology. In the context of this scenario, the Universe originates from a nonsingular static state. In the present work, considering the realization of the emergent universe scenario, we address the possibility of having a nonsingular Kantowski-Sachs type static state.

arxiv-2207-08503.title: Auto-Positioning in Radio-based Localization Systems: A Bayesian Approach
arxiv-2207-08503.creator: 1 st Andrea Jung, 2 nd Paul Schwarzbach, 3 rd Oliver Michler
arxiv-2207-08503.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by 1 st Andrea Jung, 2 nd Paul Schwarzbach, 3 rd Oliver Michler. The application of radio-based positioning systems is ever increasing. In light of the dissemination of the Internet of Things and location-aware communication systems, the demands on localization architectures and amount of possible use cases steadily increases. While traditional radio-based localization is performed by utilizing stationary nodes, whose positions are absolutely referenced, collaborative auto-positioning methods aim to estimate location information without any a-priori knowledge of the node distribution.

arxiv-2211-07158.title: General-relativistic neutrino-radiation magnetohydrodynamics simulation of seconds-long black hole-neutron star mergers: Dependence on initial magnetic field strength, configuration, and neutron-star equation of state
arxiv-2211-07158.creator: Kota Hayashi 1 , Kenta Kiuchi 2,1 , Koutarou Kyutoku 3,1,4 , Yuichiro Sekiguchi 5,1 , Masaru Shibata 2,1
arxiv-2211-07158.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kota Hayashi 1 , Kenta Kiuchi 2,1 , Koutarou Kyutoku 3,1,4 , Yuichiro Sekiguchi 5,1 , Masaru Shibata 2,1. As a follow-up study of our previous work Hayashi et al. 2022 , numerical-relativity simulations for seconds-long black hole-neutron star mergers are performed for a variety of setups.

arxiv-2402-09086.title: Impact of Non-Informative Censoring on Propensity Score Based Estimation of Marginal Hazard Ratios
arxiv-2402-09086.creator: Guilherme W. F. Barros, Jenny Häggström
arxiv-2402-09086.description: Abstract In medical and epidemiological studies, one of the most common settings is studying the effect of a treatment on a time-to-event outcome, where the time-to-event might be censored before end of study. A common parameter of interest in such a setting is the marginal hazard ratio (MHR).

arxiv-2404-17722.title: Simulating Crystallization in a Colloidal System Using State Predictive Information Bottleneck based Enhanced Sampling
arxiv-2404-17722.creator: Vanessa J. Meraz, Ziyue Zou, Pratyush Tiwary
arxiv-2404-17722.description: Abstract Abstract We investigate crystal nucleation in supersaturated colloid suspensions using enhanced molecular dynamics simulations augmented with machine learning techniques. The simulations reveal that crystallization in the model colloidal system studied here, with particles interacting through a repulsive screened Coulomb Yukawa potential, proceeds from vapor to dense liquid droplet to crystalline phases across multiple high barriers.

arxiv-2408-13559.title: Interaction of a black hole with scalar field in cosmology background
arxiv-2408-13559.creator: Malik Almatwi
arxiv-2408-13559.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Recent data from elliptical galaxies indicate that the growth in the masses of black holes exceeds what is expected from the accretion of surrounding matter, and this growth appears to be dependent on the expansion of the universe.

arxiv-2409-06589.title: Seg-HGNN: Unsupervised and Light-Weight Image Segmentation with Hyperbolic Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2409-06589.creator: Debjyoti Mondal, Rahul Mishra, Chandan Pandey
arxiv-2409-06589.description: Abstract Image analysis in the euclidean space through linear hyperspaces is well studied. However, in the quest for more effective image representations, we turn to hyperbolic manifolds. They provide a compelling alternative to capture complex hierarchical relationships in images with remarkably small dimensionality.

arxiv-2410-20305.title: Accelerating Direct Preference Optimization with Prefix Sharing
arxiv-2410-20305.creator: Franklin Wang *, Sumanth Hegde *
arxiv-2410-20305.description: Abstract Offline paired preference optimization algorithms have become a popular approach for fine-tuning on preference data, outperforming traditional supervised fine-tuning in various tasks. However, traditional implementations often involve redundant computations, especially for tasks with long shared prompts. We introduce prefix sharing for preference tuning, a novel technique that processes chosen and rejected responses as one sequence with a shared prefix.

arxiv-2504-10454.title: Dynamical Systems Approach to Non-Slow-Roll Inflationary Models
arxiv-2504-10454.creator: Sandip Biswas, Saddam Hussain, Kaushik Bhattacharya
arxiv-2504-10454.description: Abstract In this work, we systematically present a new dynamical systems approach to nonstandard inflationary processes as constant-roll inflation and ultraslow-roll inflation. Using the techniques presented in our work one can in general investigate the attractor nature of the inflationary models in the phase space.

arxiv-2511-00808.title: Do Math - Reasoning LLMs Help Predict the Impact of Public Transit Events? Journal: Transportation Research Part C Special Issue “Foundation Models and Large Language Models in Urban Mobility"
arxiv-2511-00808.creator: Bowen Fang, Ruijian Zha, Xuan Di
arxiv-2511-00808.description: Abstract Predicting public transit incident duration from unstructured text alerts is a critical but challenging task. Addressing the domain sparsity of transit operations with standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is difficult, as the task involves noisy, continuous labels and lacks reliable expert demonstrations for reasoning.

arxiv-2601-12472.title: Development of a novel compact and fast SiPM-based RICH detector for the future ALICE 3 PID system at LHC
arxiv-2601-12472.creator: M. N. Mazziotta, A. R. Altamura, L. Congedo, G. De Robertis, A. Di Mauro, J. O. Guerra-Pulido, F. Licciulli, L. Lorusso, P. Martinengo, E. Nappi, N. Nicassio, G. Paić, G. Panzarini, R. Pillera, G. Volpe
arxiv-2601-12472.description: Abstract A dedicated R&D is ongoing for the charged particle identification system of the ALICE 3 experiment proposed for the LHC Run 5 and beyond. One of the subsystems for the high-energy charged particle identification will be a Ring-Imaging Cherenkov (RICH) detector. The possibility of integrating Cherenkov-based charged particle timing measurements is currently under study.

arxiv-2601-15086.title: Memory Retention Is Not Enough to Master Memory Tasks in Reinforcement Learning Conference: Proc. of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026); May 25 – 29, 2026; Paphos, Cyprus 792 CCS: Computing methodologies Reinforcement learning
arxiv-2601-15086.creator: Oleg Shchendrigin, Egor Cherepanov, Alexey K. Kovalev, Aleksandr I. Panov
arxiv-2601-15086.description: Abstract . Effective decision-making in the real world depends on memory that is both stable and adaptive: environments change over time, and agents must retain relevant information over long horizons while also updating or overwriting outdated content when circumstances shift.

arxiv-2602-07172.title: Some Remarks on Super M p M_{p} -groups
arxiv-2602-07172.creator: Xiaoyou Chen, Ali Reza Moghaddamfar
arxiv-2602-07172.description: Abstract . Let G G be a finite group and p p be a prime divisor of | G | |G| . An irreducible p p -Brauer character φ \varphi of G G is called super-monomial if every primitive p p -Brauer character inducing φ \varphi is linear.

britannica-1911-oglethorpe-james-edward.title: Oglethorpe, James Edward (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-oglethorpe-james-edward.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-oglethorpe-james-edward.description: Article 'Oglethorpe, James Edward' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. general and philanthropist, the founder of the state of Georgia, was born in London on the 21st of December 1696, the son of Sir Theophilus Oglethorpe (1650–1702) of Westbrook Place, Godalming, Surrey. He entered Corpus Christi College, Oxford, in 1714, but in the same year joined the army of Prince Eugene.

pmc-10605882.title: Acoustic Radiation Force Impulse (ARFI) Elastography of Focal Splenic Lesions: Feasibility and Diagnostic Potential
pmc-10605882.creator: Amjad Alhyari, Christian Görg, Suhaib Tahat, Corinna Trenker, Christoph Frank Dietrich, Christina C. Westhoff, Ehsan Safai Zadeh, Hajo Findeisen
pmc-10605882.description: Simple SummaryNontraumatic focal splenic lesions (FSL) are rare, and the need for tissue diagnosis must be weighed against the risk of complication after a splenic biopsy. The aim of this retrospective study was to explore the diagnostic potential of acoustic radiation force impulse elastography (ARFI) as a noninvasive method for benign and malignant FSL.

pmc-10740666.title: Boar Seminal Microbiota in Relation to Sperm Quality under Tropical Environments
pmc-10740666.creator: CongBang Ngo, Junpen Suwimonteerabutr, Prasert Apiwatsiri, Imporn Saenkankam, Nuvee Prapasarakul, Jane M Morrell, Padet Tummaruk, Aleksandra Kurzyńska, Agata Żmijewska, Grzegorz Panasiewicz
pmc-10740666.description: Simple SummarySemen possesses unique microbiota that are distinct from other microbial populations, such as those in the piglet gut and sow vagina. Environmental variations can result in alterations in the bacterial composition, which might not be detrimental but instead could be essential for sustaining optimal sperm functionality.

pmc-11479554.title: Cofilin linked to GluN2B subunits of NMDA receptors is required for behavioral sensitization by changing the dendritic spines of neurons in the caudate and putamen after repeated nicotine exposure
pmc-11479554.creator: Sunghyun Kim, Sumin Sohn, Eun Sang Choe
pmc-11479554.description: BackgroundNicotine dependence is associated with glutamatergic neurotransmission in the caudate and putamen (CPu) of the forebrain which includes alterations in the structure of dendritic spines at glutamate synapses. These changes after nicotine exposure can lead to the development of habitual behaviors such as smoking.

pmc-11646064.title: P056 Comparison of Breas Vivo 45 LS and ResMed Lumis ventilators in three simulated disease conditions
pmc-11646064.creator: R Hone, T Churchward, N Sheers, L Rautela, J Tolson, M Howard, D Berlowtiz
pmc-11646064.description: BackgroundVentilator performance has been shown to vary across conditions, ventilator type, and in common scenarios such as mask leak. Aim: This study sought to compare the performance of a Breas Medical AB (Mölnlycke, Sweden) Vivo 45 LS™ and ResMed (San Diego, CA, USA) Lumis™ ventilator.

pmc-11859282.title: Determinants of hospital length of stay for patients with schizophrenia
pmc-11859282.creator: M Turki, M Barkallah, N Boussaid, A labyadh, S Ellouze, N Halouani, J Aloulou
pmc-11859282.description: Introductionrelapse and frequent rehospitalizations. The length of stay (LOS) of these patients has been a concern of researchers. The ability to identify determinants of LOS at admission – and, thus, identify patients who are likely to need a longer stay early on – may help treatment planning.

pmc-11932417.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a digital tool to support community-based screening for COVID-19 and other priority medical conditions across rural and peri-urban communities in Guinea
pmc-11932417.creator: Nasser Diallo, Mamadou Bobo, Aboubacar Diallo, Abdoul Karim Baldé, Alpha Oumar Bah, Mamady Kourouma, Mamady Cisse, Nick Banks, Rigveda Kadam, Khairunisa Suleiman, Paula Akugizibwe
pmc-11932417.description: Access to primary healthcare, including diagnostic testing, is limited in Guinea, particularly for low-income residents of rural communities. Here we share findings from an interventional operational research study evaluating the feasibility of deploying a digital tool and rapid diagnostic tests to support community-based testing for priority medical conditions across three rural and peri-urban communities in Guinea.

pmc-12426258.title: Meta-analysis of the efficacy of rituximab in the management of cryoglobulinemic vasculitis
pmc-12426258.creator: Ling Zhou, Jianxia Dong, Zehui Deng, Shaojuan Wang, Mengjie Fu, Jingjing Peng, Jian Zhang
pmc-12426258.description: IntroductionA primary goal of this study was to systematically assess the efficacy of rituximab (RTX) in treating cryoglobulinemic vasculitis (CV).MethodsA prospectively registered meta-analysis was conducted to examine eligible randomized controlled trials (RCTs) or cohort studies through searches across PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Web of Science, with a search period up to February 12, 2025.

pmc-12445460.title: Efficiency analysis of 67 Chinese research universities considering inter-university heterogeneity: Evidence from a meta-frontier network SBM DEA model
pmc-12445460.creator: Bo Cheng
pmc-12445460.description: With the continuous increase in technology research and development investment, the overall operational efficiency of universities as the main body of scientific research has always been a focus of research. This study evaluates the efficiency of technology transfer in 67 Chinese universities directly affiliated with the Ministry of Education from 2016 to 2020.

pmc-12516023.title: Co‐Designing Peer Support for Women Labelled With Intellectual Disabilities Who Have Experienced Sexual Violence
pmc-12516023.creator: Alexis Buettgen, Tammy Bernasky, Kelly MacDougall, Ann Fudge Schormans, Jennifer Gordon, Sandra Tavares, Verónica Schiariti, Robin Mason, Janice Du Mont, Maria Huijbregts
pmc-12516023.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundWomen labelled with intellectual disabilities face high rates of social exclusion and sexual violence, with limited research and few services tailored to their needs. Peer support offers many benefits including recognition of diverse lived experiences and nonprofessional perspectives.

pmc-12547560.title: Evaluating the Enantioselective Neurotoxicity of Organophosphorus Pollutant Dioxabenzofos: Mechanistic Studies Employing Cellular, Molecular, and Computational Toxicology Assays
pmc-12547560.creator: Zhi-Cong He, Tao Zhang, Xin-Fang Lu, Rui Li, Qiong Mei, Qi-Zhao Wang, Fei Ding, Wei Peng
pmc-12547560.description: Chiral organophosphorus pollutants are widely distributed in different environmental matrices, but their health risks to humans remain insufficiently explored. This study explored the acetylcholinesterase (AChE)-mediated enantioselective neurotoxicity of dioxabenzofos on SH-SY5Y cells and elucidated the microscopic mechanisms underlying neurotoxicity at the enantiomeric level.

pmc-12960057.title: Non‐Invasive Assessment of Complete Regression in Endometrial Cancer Patients Undergoing Fertility Preservation Using MRI‐Based Radiomics and Immune Heterogeneity
pmc-12960057.creator: Xingchen Li, Kun Shang, Jingyuan Wang, Aoxuan Zhu, Yuman Wu, Yue Qi, Xinyi Bi, Yiqin Wang, Jianliu Wang
pmc-12960057.description: Fertility‐preserving treatment (FPT) offers a critical option for young women diagnosed with atypical endometrial hyperplasia (AEH) or early‐stage endometrial cancer (EC), however, the commonly used methods for evaluating complete regression (CR) are invasive. This study aimed to develop a non‐invasive tool to predict treatment outcomes using radiomics and molecular profiling.

pmc-12985665.title: Reduced multiplicity of crystallographic sites for superior thermoelectric performance of cubic Cu6GeTeS4 via chemical tailoring
pmc-12985665.creator: Ya Yang, Ying Zhang, Zixuan Chen, Pengju Han, Shuailiang Chen, Chong Hua, Yunpeng Zheng, Hongwei Ming, Naifeng Zhuang, Zhong-Zhen Luo, Zhigang Zou
pmc-12985665.description: Argyrodites have garnered substantial interest as ultralow lattice thermal conductivity (κlat) materials. However, their development is constrained by poor thermal stability and inferior thermoelectric performance. Here, a cubic argyrodite compound, Cu6GeTeS4, was successfully synthesized via a chemical-tailoring strategy. Moreover, a strong correlation between the multiplicity of crystallographic sites and ion mobility was found.

pmc-13142023.title: Multiple adult xanthogranulomas associated with breast cancer
pmc-13142023.creator: Samantha Bizimungu, Annie Bélisle, Philippe Watson
pmc-13142023.description: this report we present a case of multiple AXG (MAXG) arising in the setting of infiltrating ductal carcinoma of the breast. Case report A 54-year-old healthy woman presented with a 4-month history of asymptomatic papules on the trunk and upper limbs.

pmc-13245931.title: Strengthening digital competencies in India’s health workforce: development and feasibility evaluation of a digital health competency framework for frontline healthcare workers in Uttar Pradesh
pmc-13245931.creator: Chirag Bariya, Himanshu Burad, Rukmani Keshav, Surbhi Arul, Umesh Jhadav, Padmini Vishwanath, Girish Patil, Karthik Adapa
pmc-13245931.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The rapid growth of digital health initiatives has heightened reliance on frontline health workers (FLHWs) to deliver, document, and manage services through digital tools, particularly in low- and middleincome countries (LMICs). In India, the widespread rollout of platforms under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is not yet matched by a standardized digital health competency framework (DHCF) for FLHWs, hindering systematic skill development, assessment, and integration. This study designed, developed, and evaluated a theory-driven, evidence-based, and scalable DHCF for India's health workforce.

pmc-13256041.title: Effects of Compound Yeast Culture and Yeast Cell Wall Polysaccharide on Intestinal Barrier Function in Mongolian Ram Lambs
pmc-13256041.creator: Songjian Li, Pengxiang Bai, Shixiong Liu, Zixuan Xu, Majigsuren Zolzaya, Dorjgoo Purevtsogt, Hui Chen, Dacheng Liu
pmc-13256041.description: Simple SummaryCompound yeast culture (CYC) is a gastrointestinal microecological preparation developed by our research team targeting the digestive tract of ruminants. Its core component is yeast polysaccharides (YPs), which consist of β-glucan (β-Glu) and mannan oligosaccharides (Man). CYC exerts beneficial effects such as promoting lamb growth, enhancing antioxidant capacity, and improving immune function.

pmc-13349730.title: Effect of combining peripheral defocus spectacle lens wear with 0.01% atropine
pmc-13349730.creator: Sayantan Biswas, James S Wolffsohn
pmc-13349730.description: ssociated with higher myopia and increased risk of myopia-related pathology (3). Thus, delaying the onset or preventing myopia through interventions before it starts would provide greater lifetime benefit, making pre-myopia an appealing target for intervention (4,5). The clinical trial by Lu et al. [2025] evaluates a new spectacle lens design in the pre-myopic disease stage (6).

pmc-13372013.title: In Vitro Antiparasitic Effects of Silver Nanoparticles on Sarcocystis Bradyzoites
pmc-13372013.creator: Nasrin Karimi, Mir‐Hassan Moosavy, Nasser Hajipour, Hamed Behniafar
pmc-13372013.description: Background Sarcocystis is a protozoan parasite of significant zoonotic and economic importance, primarily transmitted through the consumption of contaminated meat. Conventional antiparasitic drugs show limited efficacy and potential side effects, leading to growing interest in nanotechnology‐based alternatives.ObjectiveThis study evaluated the in vitro antiparasitic activity of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) against Sarcocystis bradyzoites isolated from sheep.

pmc-13503684.title: Robust rice-crab detection via receptive-field attention and feature reassembly in unstructured agricultural scenes
pmc-13503684.creator: Zhipeng He, Xinying Miao, Xiaodong Li, Na Sun, Yi Zhang, Menghan Liu, Jingjing Shan, Huatang Sun

pmc-13564979.title: Stable-Isotope Differentiation of Mature Ovarian Eggs from Anadromous and Freshwater-Resident Coilia nasus
pmc-13564979.creator: Tao Jiang, Shubing Lin, Xiubao Chen, Junren Xue
pmc-13564979.description: Simple SummaryThe two fish populations could be distinguished by the chemical signatures of their eggs: one group migrated from the sea to freshwater to spawn (anadromous), and the other resided in freshwater throughout its life. Mature, unfertilized eggs were collected from the ovaries of female fish that were ready to spawn in Poyang Lake, China.

pmc-13588991.title: Intracranial venous thrombosis imaging by anatomical location: an educational review with mimics and diagnostic pitfalls
pmc-13588991.creator: Anna Falk Delgado, David Fällmar, Heather Martin, Michael V Mazya, Fabian Arnberg, Annika Kits
pmc-13588991.description: AbstractIntracranial venous thrombosis encompasses diverse etiologies with clinical presentations ranging from an incidental finding to coma and death. Despite potentially devastating consequences, venous thrombosis is frequently overlooked by radiologists due to its predominantly extraaxial location close to the skull and clinical emphasis on arterial imaging evaluation in acute stroke management.
